capability.title: Site Footer
capability.description: Shared site footer with the brand mark and tagline, link columns, contact details, opening hours, and a bottom copyright bar.
useWhen: The site needs one shared footer rendered across every page
Link columns, contact details, and hours should appear together below the content
avoidWhen: A page needs a local end-of-page block rather than the site-wide footer
There are no link columns, contact details, or hours to list
